definitions.explanation: A person who has just graduated or is about to graduate from a school or university. In Japan, this term is closely tied to the annual mass-hiring system where companies recruit students before graduation.

examples.japanese: {新卒|しんそつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the company as a new graduate.

examples.japanese: {新卒|しんそつ}{採用|さいよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Interviews for new graduate recruitment have begun.

examples.japanese: {新卒|しんそつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Job hunting for new graduates often starts in the second half of the third year of university.

notes:
USAGE:
A key term in Japanese employment culture. Japan's {新卒|しんそつ}⟦{一括|いっかつ}→一括：08947_ikkatsu⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ (mass hiring of new graduates) system means most large companies hire graduates simultaneously each April. Missing this window can significantly impact career prospects. Often used as a modifier: {新卒|しんそつ} + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新卒|しんそつ}{採用|さいよう}: new graduate recruitment
- {新卒|しんそつ}⟦{一括|いっかつ}→一括：08947_ikkatsu⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧: mass hiring of new graduates
- {新卒|しんそつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}する→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧: to join a company as a new graduate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既卒|きそつ}→既卒：15162_kisotsu⟧: previous graduate (someone who graduated but did not find employment immediately)
- ⟦{中途|ちゅうと}{採用|さいよう}→中途採用：17725_chuutosaiyou⟧: mid-career hiring
